hero_eyebrow: A historic space with a modern spirit
hero_lede: Four rooms that work on their own or run together as one evening. Here is what each one holds, so you can stop guessing whether your list fits. Every wedding venue in Waterloo quotes one maximum capacity; this page breaks it down room by room instead, including what works for a small wedding rather than a Kitchener banquet hall.
objection_1_a: 100 seated in the Theatre for a ceremony, 140 standing across the Theatre and Lobby Bar. Seated dinner with a dance floor depends on your table plan — send the guest count and you get the layout back.
objection_2_q: “Can we use more than one room?”
objection_2_a: That is the normal shape of a wedding here. The Theatre and Lobby Bar run as one evening, and the Library can be added for a smaller sitting.
objection_3_a: Tell the events team early. The rooms combine, so the plan usually flexes without changing the date or the venue.
room_1_body: The ceremony room. Elevated seating in velvet, a 16-foot video wall, wireless microphones, Sonos and lighting you can set to your colours. Flexible furniture, so the same room turns over for dinner and dancing while your guests are next door.
room_2_meta: Up to 140 with the Theatre, standing
room_2_body: Full bar, ornate chandeliers, original wood, accessible washrooms and direct catering access. Where guests arrive, where cocktails happen during the turnover, and where the night tends to end.
room_3_body: One long-table room with a video screen and custom seating. Right for a micro wedding, a rehearsal dinner or a shower. Available as an add-on to a Theatre rental from $1,000 per hour, or booked on its own.
room_4_body: Your caterer works from a real kitchen inside the building. It is the reason plated food arrives hot and service does not stall between courses.
count_intro: Venues quote one maximum. These are the five numbers that decide a wedding.
count_1_v: Up to 100 seated in the Theatre, on elevated seating so the back row still sees the vows.
count_2_v: Up to 140 across the Theatre and the Lobby Bar with the rooms open to each other.
count_3_v: Driven by your table plan and how much dance floor you want, not by a single headline number. Send the guest count and the events team returns the layout that fits it.
count_4_v: The Library holds four 16-foot harvest tables — one long table rather than a room of round ones.
count_5_v: The normal shape of a wedding here: ceremony in the Theatre, cocktails in the Lobby Bar, back into the Theatre for dinner.
